name: A Single Card

positions.name: The Answer
frames: {card} answers you: {essence}.
The cards give you one answer, and it is {card}: {essence}.
I turn a single card, and it speaks of {essence}.

openings: One card, then. Let us see what it holds.
A single question deserves a single answer. Here it is.
Hush. One card is enough, if it is the right one.

name: Past, Present, Future
desc: Three cards laid left to right.

positions.name: The Past
frames: Behind you lies {card}: {essence}.
In what you have left behind, I see {essence}.
Your past is marked by {card}. It speaks of {essence}.

positions.name: The Present
frames: Here and now, {card} holds you: {essence}.
What surrounds you today is {essence}.
In your present I see {card}, and with it {essence}.

positions.name: The Future
frames: Ahead, the road bends toward {essence}.
{card} waits in what is to come: {essence}.
What lies before you, if nothing changes, is {essence}.

openings: Three cards: where you come from, where you stand, where you go.
Let us follow the thread from its beginning.
The cards lie in a row, like a road. Let me walk it for you.

name: The Cross
desc: Five cards: the matter, what lies behind and ahead, above and below.

positions.name: The Heart of the Matter
frames: At the heart of the matter lies {card}: {essence}.
{card} sits at the centre of it all: {essence}.
At the very heart of your question, I see {essence}.

positions.name: What Lies Behind
frames: It grew out of {essence}.
Behind it, {card} still casts its shadow: {essence}.
What brought you here was {essence}.

positions.name: What Lies Ahead
frames: It is moving toward {essence}.
Ahead, {card} waits: {essence}.
What comes next is {essence}.

positions.name: What Crowns It
frames: At best, it crowns itself in {essence}.
Above it all hangs {card}, what you hope for or fear the most: {essence}.
What you reach for is {essence}.

positions.name: What Lies Beneath
frames: Beneath it, unseen, lies {essence}.
{card} lies under everything, at its root: {essence}.
What you do not say aloud is {essence}.

openings: Five cards, and you at their centre. Let us begin with the heart.
The cross is laid. Every arm of it speaks of you.
This is an old spread, and it does not lie easily. Listen.
